summary: Iteration 6 — HT/TTC pricing + Season (global + per-product) feature verified end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_season_httc.py — (1) GET /api/settings/season returns {season:'all'} publicly (no auth), (2) PUT /api/admin/settings/season with valid seasons ('winter','summer','all') → 200 and value round-trips via public GET, (3) invalid season → 422, (4) non-admin PUT → 403, (5) no-token PUT → 401/403, (6) POST /admin/products with price_kg=3.0, price_kg_ttc=3.30, season='summer' → 201 with all three persisted and price_piece_ttc=null, (7) with current_season='winter' GET /products EXCLUDES the summer melon while still returning all season='all' seed products, (8) switching to 'summer' re-includes the melon, (9) 'all' returns everything, (10) PUT /admin/products/{id} updates price_kg_ttc from 3.30→3.50 and GET confirms persistence, (11) all seed products have season='all' post-migration, (12) every product exposes price_kg_ttc and price_piece_ttc fields. Frontend: Admin login → dashboard shows nav-season row → Season screen renders exactly 3 options (season-opt-all, season-opt-summer, season-opt-winter), tapping 'Été' shows 'Saison mise à jour' toast and 'En cours' badge appears on the active card. Product edit form on Pommes Gala exposes all 7 required testIDs (edit-price-kg, edit-price-piece, edit-price-kg-ttc, edit-price-piece-ttc, season-all, season-summer, season-winter) plus 'Prix HT (Pros)', 'Prix TTC (Particuliers)', 'Saison' section labels — filling TTC kg=3.30, selecting 'Été', saving fires 'Produit mis à jour' toast, and re-opening the same product shows 3.3 persisted. Business login (test@leray.fr): catalog shows 'X.XX € HT / kg', product detail shows 'Sous-total HT' (no TTC label). Personal login (perso+ttctest@leray.fr, created via /auth/register-personal): catalog shows 'X.XX € TTC / kg', product detail shows 'Sous-total TTC' (no HT label). Seasonal filtering visible to clients: with global season=winter, created summer product hidden from GET /api/products (15 items) — with season=summer it reappears (16 items) — confirmed at API level; personal client under winter still sees 15 season='all' products. Cleanup: test melons deleted, season reset to 'all'. Deprecated packages/RN issues: pre-existing pointerEvents deprecation warning on toast (carried from iter 3-5) — no new ones.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/toast.tsx:38

action_items: Optional: move pointerEvents='none' from prop to style in /app/frontend/src/toast.tsx to silence the RN deprecation warning (pre-existing, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `SeasonIn` correctly validates season∈{'summer','winter','all'} via field_validator → 422 on invalid; `_get_current_season()` safely falls back to 'all' if the settings doc is missing.
server.py `/settings/season` is intentionally public (no Depends) — appropriate since it's needed by the auth screen and public catalog listing.
server.py `/admin/settings/season` is admin-guarded via Depends(require_admin) → 403 for non-admin, 401 for no token. Verified.
server.py `list_products` correctly applies `q['season'] = {'$in': ['all', current]}` only when current != 'all', so season='all' returns everything (correct global toggle behavior).

server.py `ProductIn` extends validator to include price_kg_ttc / price_piece_ttc (>0 or null) and season enum; `resolved()` still requires at least one of price_kg/price_piece (HT) which correctly enforces the pro-price as the source of truth for cart pricing. TTC fields are pure display overrides.
server.py startup migration back-fills season='all' and price_kg_ttc/price_piece_ttc=null on legacy docs — verified by test_11 and test_12.
cart-context.tsx `priceForTtc` falls back to `priceForHt` when TTC price is not filled — good defensive default so partially-migrated products don't blank out for personal users.
cart-context.tsx `priceModeFor(user)` returns 'ttc' only when account_type==='personal' — admin and business both see HT, as specified.
product-edit.tsx exposes correct testIDs for both HT and TTC blocks and 3 season chips; season chip visual state (active pill) correctly persists across re-open (verified 3.3 persistence).
product-detail.tsx displays 'Sous-total HT' / 'Sous-total TTC' via priceLabelFor(mode) — dynamically follows the logged-in user account_type.
(admin)/index.tsx dashboard adds nav-season row alongside pending/banner/orders/products — no layout regression observed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Season screen 3 options + toast/badge; product-edit HT+TTC+3 season chips + persistence; business HT catalog+detail; personal TTC catalog+detail; season filter hides/shows summer melon under winter/summer via API)
